entities.name: Bryd
entities.description: A human Coppercoat colonel from Drannith, dutiful but petulant and distrustful.

entities.name: Jirina Kudro
entities.description: General and daughter of General Kudro; Bryd serves under her.

entities.name: Kudro
entities.description: General whose death just before the Siege of Drannith left Bryd reassigned.

entities.name: Vivien
entities.description: Planeswalker and ally of Jirina whom Bryd mistrusted.

entities.name: Drannith
entities.description: City on Ikoria that Bryd is from.

entities.name: Lavabrink
entities.description: Town the column was a half day's march from.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Bryd approached Jirina.

entities.name: Siege of Drannith
entities.description: Siege before which General Kudro died.

events.summary: General Kudro dies; Bryd is reassigned from second in command to Kudro's daughter Jirina.
events.quote: After the General's death just before the Siege of Drannith , Bryd was assigned to Kudro's daugher, Jirina Kudro .

events.summary: Bryd proposes sending a detachment ahead to Lavabrink, but Jirina rejects it.
events.quote: Jirina rejected his proposal, insisting they needed all their fighters with the main group.

events.summary: Bryd voices mistrust of Vivien and is sharply rebuked.
events.quote: Bryd expressed his mistrust of Vivien

events.summary: A Phyrexian beast attacks and unseats Bryd; afterward he obeys Jirina's order to change course.
events.quote: After the battle, he followed Jirina's command to change course

relations.note: Assigned to her after her father's death.
relations.quote: Bryd was assigned to Kudro's daugher, Jirina Kudro .
Bryd was previously second in command to General Kudro .
Bryd expressed his mistrust of Vivien
